test_dictionary_gpt2_tokenize: test the DictionaryAgent gpt2_tokenize method to tokenize text with GPT2 BPE tokenization
test_dictionary_space_tokenize: test the DictionaryAgent space_tokenize method to split text by whitespace into tokens
test_dictionary_split_tokenize: test the DictionaryAgent split_tokenize method to split text handling limited punctuation
test_dictionary_ngrams: test the find_ngrams function to recognize uni bi and trigrams from a token list
test_dictionary_bytelevelbpe_tokenize: test the DictionaryAgent bytelevelbpe_tokenize method to tokenize text with ByteLevel BPE tokenization
